ns2:course.label: Current Topics in Business
ns2:course.description: Subject offerings of new and developing areas of knowledge in Business. See Class Schedule or departmental course information for topics. 1 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated up if topics vary to a maximum of 20 hours in the same semester and a maximum of 30 hours in separate semesters.
